units.text: Chapter 1. GENERAL PROVISIONS

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.label: Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 1. This Federal Law governs relations aimed at meeting state and municipal needs in order to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of procurement of goods, works and services, ensure the openness and transparency of such procurement, and prevent corruption and other abuses in such procurement, in respect of:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 1) planning the procurement of goods, works and services;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 2) selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers);
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 3) concluding the contracts provided for by this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 4) special aspects of contract performance;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 5) monitoring the procurement of goods, works and services;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 6) auditing the procurement of goods, works and services;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 7) control of compliance with legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual system for the procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs (hereinafter, procurement control).
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 2. This Federal Law does not apply to relations connected with:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 1) the provision of services by international financial organizations established under international treaties to which the Russian Federation is a party, and by international financial organizations with which the Russian Federation has concluded international treaties;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 2) procurement of goods, works and services to ensure the safety of persons subject to state protection under Federal Law of 20 August 2004 No. 119-FZ “On State Protection of Victims, Witnesses and Other Participants in Criminal Proceedings” and Federal Law of 20 April 1995 No. 45-FZ “On State Protection of Judges and Officials of Law Enforcement and Supervisory Bodies”;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 3) procurement of precious metals and precious stones to replenish the State Fund of Precious Metals and Precious Stones of the Russian Federation and the state funds of precious metals and precious stones of the constituent entities of the Russian Federation in whose territories those precious metals and precious stones were extracted;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 4) appointment of an advocate by a body of inquiry, a preliminary investigation body or a court to act as defence counsel in criminal proceedings under the Code of Criminal Procedure of the Russian Federation, or by a court to act as a representative in civil proceedings under the Code of Civil Procedure of the Russian Federation or in administrative proceedings under the Code of Administrative Court Procedure of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 5) engaging an advocate to provide citizens with free legal aid under Federal Law of 21 November 2011 No. 324-FZ “On Free Legal Aid in the Russian Federation”;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 6) procurement of goods, works and services by precinct election commissions, territorial election commissions, including where they are vested with the powers of another election commission, and district election commissions in the exercise of powers provided for by legislation of the Russian Federation on elections and referendums;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 7) engagement of citizens by election commissions and referendum commissions, under civil-law contracts concluded with individuals in accordance with Federal Law of 12 June 2002 No. 67-FZ “On Basic Guarantees of Electoral Rights and the Right of Citizens of the Russian Federation to Participate in Referendums”, to perform work and provide services connected with supporting the exercise of the powers of election commissions and referendum commissions during the preparation and conduct of elections and referendums;
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 8) not applicable from 31 July 2018. — Federal Law of 03.07.2016 No. 266-FZ; repealed. — Federal Law of 08.08.2024 No. 318-FZ;
units.label: Point 8 Part 2 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 9) procurement of goods, works and services by the Central Election Commission of the Russian Federation and election commissions of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, including where they are vested with the powers of a district election commission, in preparing and conducting elections to state authorities;
units.label: Point 9 Part 2 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 9.1) procurement of goods, works and services by election commissions of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and territorial election commissions using funds allocated from the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation or the budget of a federal territory to assist in preparing and conducting elections to federal state authorities;
units.label: Point 9.1 Part 2 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 10) the charging of a fee by an electronic platform operator or a specialized electronic platform operator in accordance with part 4 of Article 24.1 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 10 Part 2 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 11) conclusion of an agreement establishing an easement in the cases and manner provided for by land legislation;
units.label: Point 11 Part 2 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 12) payment of court costs (costs) in the cases and manner provided for by the Commercial Procedure Code of the Russian Federation, the Code of Civil Procedure of the Russian Federation, the Code of Administrative Court Procedure of the Russian Federation and the Code of Criminal Procedure of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 12 Part 2 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Scope of this Federal Law
units.text: 3. In the cases provided for by this Federal Law, special rules governing the relations specified in part 1 of this Article may be established by separate federal laws.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 2. Legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual system for the procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs
units.text: Article 2. Legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual system for the procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs
units.label: Art. 2

units.locator: Article 2. Legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual system for the procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs
units.text: 1. Legislation of the Russian Federation on the contractual system for the procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs (hereinafter, legislation of the Russian Federation on the contractual procurement system) is based on the provisions of the Constitution of the Russian Federation, the Civil Code of the Russian Federation and the Budget Code of the Russian Federation and consists of this Federal Law and other federal laws governing the relations specified in part 1 of Article 1 of this Federal Law. Legal provisions contained in other federal laws governing those relations must comply with this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 2

units.locator: Article 2. Legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual system for the procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs
units.text: 2. In the cases provided for by legislation of the Russian Federation on the contractual procurement system, the President of the Russian Federation, the Government of the Russian Federation, federal executive bodies, the State Atomic Energy Corporation “Rosatom” and the State Corporation for Space Activities “Roscosmos” may adopt regulatory legal acts governing the relations specified in part 1 of Article 1 of this Federal Law (hereinafter, regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system).
units.label: Part 2 Art. 2

units.locator: Article 2. Legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual system for the procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs
units.text: 3. State authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, public authorities of a federal territory and local self-government bodies, within their respective competence and in the cases provided for by legislation of the Russian Federation on the contractual procurement system, shall adopt legal acts governing the relations specified in part 1 of Article 1 of this Federal Law. These legal acts must comply with the regulatory legal acts specified in parts 1 and 2 of this Article.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 2

units.locator: Article 2. Legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual system for the procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs
units.text: 4. If an international treaty of the Russian Federation establishes rules other than those provided for by this Federal Law, the rules of that international treaty shall apply.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 2

units.locator: Article 2. Legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual system for the procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs
units.text: 4.1. Decisions of interstate bodies adopted on the basis of provisions of international treaties of the Russian Federation as interpreted in a manner contrary to the Constitution of the Russian Federation shall not be enforceable in the Russian Federation. Such a contradiction may be established in the manner specified by a federal constitutional law.
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 2

units.locator: Article 2. Legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual system for the procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs
units.text: 5. Federal laws amending provisions of this Federal Law concerning the planning of procurement of goods, works and services, the selection of suppliers (contractors, service providers), including the introduction of new methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers), procurement control, monitoring of procurement of goods, works and services, or audit of procurement of goods, works and services shall enter into force no earlier than 1 January of the calendar year following the year of their adoption. If such federal laws are adopted after 1 November of the current calendar year, they shall instead enter into force no earlier than 1 January of the year following the next calendar year.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 2

units.locator: Article 2. Legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual system for the procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs
units.text: 6. The provisions of this Federal Law concerning constituent entities of the Russian Federation, their executive bodies regulating the contractual procurement system, and their state authorities empowered to regulate and control procurement shall apply, respectively, to federal territories and to public authorities of federal territories empowered to regulate and control procurement.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 2

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.label: Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 1. The following basic concepts are used for the purposes of this Federal Law:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 1) contractual system for the procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs (hereinafter, the contractual procurement system): the entirety of participants in that system (the federal executive body regulating the contractual procurement system; executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation regulating that system; other federal executive bodies, state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and local self-government bodies empowered to regulate and control procurement; the State Atomic Energy Corporation “Rosatom”; the State Corporation for Space Activities “Roscosmos”; contracting authorities; procurement participants, including those recognized as suppliers, contractors or service providers; authorized bodies; authorized institutions; specialized organizations; electronic platform operators; and specialized electronic platform operators) and the actions they take, including through the unified procurement information system (except where this Federal Law does not provide for the use of that system), in accordance with legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system, to meet state and municipal needs;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 2) selection of a supplier (contractor, service provider): the set of actions taken by contracting authorities in the manner established by this Federal Law, starting with publication of a notice of procurement of goods, works or services to meet state needs (federal needs or the needs of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation) or municipal needs, or, in the cases established by this Federal Law, with the sending of an invitation to participate in the selection of a supplier (contractor, service provider), and ending with the conclusion of a contract;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 3) procurement of goods, works or services to meet state or municipal needs (hereinafter, procurement): the set of actions taken by a contracting authority in the manner established by this Federal Law to meet state or municipal needs. Procurement starts with the selection of a supplier (contractor, service provider) and ends with the parties to the contract fulfilling their obligations. Where this Federal Law does not provide for publication of a procurement notice or the sending of an invitation to participate in the selection of a supplier (contractor, service provider), procurement starts with conclusion of the contract and ends with the parties to the contract fulfilling their obligations;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 4) procurement participant: any legal entity, irrespective of its organizational and legal form, form of ownership, location or place of origin of its capital, except a legal entity registered in a state or territory included in the list of states and territories used for intermediate (offshore) ownership of assets in the Russian Federation approved under point 15 of Article 241 of the Budget Code of the Russian Federation (hereinafter, an offshore company), or a legal entity that is a foreign agent under Federal Law of 14 July 2022 No. 255-FZ “On Control over the Activities of Persons under Foreign Influence”; or any individual, including an individual registered as an individual entrepreneur, except an individual who is a foreign agent under Federal Law of 14 July 2022 No. 255-FZ “On Control over the Activities of Persons under Foreign Influence”;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 4.1) supplier (contractor, service provider): a procurement participant with whom a contract has been concluded in accordance with this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 4.1 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 5) state contracting authority: a state body (including a state authority), the State Atomic Energy Corporation “Rosatom”, the State Corporation for Space Activities “Roscosmos”, the public-law company “Unified Contracting Authority in Construction”, a governing body of a state extrabudgetary fund, or a state treasury institution, acting on behalf of the Russian Federation or a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, authorized to assume budgetary obligations on behalf of the Russian Federation or a constituent entity of the Russian Federation under budget legislation of the Russian Federation, and conducting procurement;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 6) municipal contracting authority: a municipal body or municipal treasury institution acting on behalf of a municipal entity, authorized to assume budgetary obligations on behalf of that municipal entity under budget legislation of the Russian Federation, and conducting procurement;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 7) contracting authority: a state or municipal contracting authority, or a budget-funded or autonomous institution, state or municipal unitary enterprise, or other legal entity conducting procurement under parts 1, 2.1, 4, 4.3 and 4.4 of Article 15 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 7.1) contracting authority operating in a foreign state: a contracting authority that is a diplomatic mission, a consular institution of the Russian Federation, a trade mission of the Russian Federation or a mission of the Russian Federation to an international (interstate, intergovernmental) organization, as well as a contracting authority operating in a foreign state;
units.label: Point 7.1 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 8) state contract or municipal contract: a civil-law agreement concluded in writing for the supply of goods, performance of works or provision of services (including acquisition of immovable property or leasing of property), concluded by a state or municipal contracting authority on behalf of the Russian Federation or a constituent entity of the Russian Federation (state contract), or a municipal entity (municipal contract), to meet state or municipal needs respectively;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 8.1) contract: a state or municipal contract, or a civil-law agreement concluded in writing for the supply of goods, performance of works or provision of services (including acquisition of immovable property or leasing of property), concluded by a budget-funded institution, a state or municipal unitary enterprise or another legal entity under parts 1, 2.1, 4, 4.3 and 4.4 of Article 15 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 8.1 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 8.2) life-cycle contract: a contract providing for the supply of goods or performance of works (including, where necessary, design of a capital construction project or creation of goods through the performance of works), and subsequent servicing, operation during the service life where necessary, repair and/or disposal of the goods supplied or of the capital construction project or goods created through the performance of works;
units.label: Point 8.2 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 8.3) contract for the supply of goods necessary for citizens’ normal subsistence: a contract providing for the supply of food, resources necessary for the provision of emergency or urgent ambulance care, including specialized ambulance care, medicines, medical devices, technical rehabilitation aids and fuel, the absence of which would disrupt citizens’ normal subsistence;
units.label: Point 8.3 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 8.4) separate stage of contract performance: a part of the supplier’s (contractor’s, service provider’s) obligation for which the contract requires the contracting authority to arrange acceptance (with an acceptance document drawn up in accordance with this Federal Law) and payment for the goods supplied, works performed or services provided;
units.label: Point 8.4 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 8.5) contract with reciprocal investment obligations: a contract for the supply of goods or provision of services concluded under Article 111.4 of this Federal Law, providing for reciprocal investment obligations of the supplier (service provider) to establish, modernize or master production of those goods and/or to create or reconstruct property (immovable property, or immovable and movable property technologically interconnected) intended for provision of those services;
units.label: Point 8.5 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 9) unified procurement information system (hereinafter, the unified information system): the entirety of the information specified in part 3 of Article 4 of this Federal Law and held in databases, and the information technologies and technical facilities that enable such information to be generated, processed, stored and made available through the official website of the unified information system on the Internet information and telecommunications network (hereinafter, the official website);
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Basic concepts used in this Federal Law
units.text: 10) authorized body or authorized institution: a state body, municipal body or treasury institution vested with the powers provided for by Article 26 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 3
